segments.normalizedSource: ```swift private func handleMaterial() { guard let terrain = viewModel.rootEntity?.terrain, let terrainMaterial = terrainMaterial else { return } do { var material = terrainMaterial try material.setParameter(name: materialParameterName, value: .float(viewModel.sliderValue)) if var component = terrain.modelComponent { component.materials = [material] terrain.components.set(component) } try terrain.update(shaderGraphMaterial: terrainMaterial, { m in try m.setParameter(name: materialParameterName, value: .float(viewModel.sliderValue)) }) } catch { print("problem: \(error)") } } ```
